The remainder62% is derived hardwood basal area in the paper's pine-versus-hardwood grouping. Older Mirfenderesgi2016 species percentages sum95% and lack explicit denominator: chestnut oak58, black14, scarlet6, white6, post3, pitch pine8; preserve as incomplete historical context.

denominator: Total basal area of inventoried live trees+saplings; not land surface cover or stem count
observation_period: 2018 after insect mortality; earlier2004-2005 inventory before infestation
spatial_scope: Five201m² census plots within100m of flux tower plus periodically sampled1km² grid; selected paper result is US-Slt oak stand, not US-Ced or US-Dix

Named associates include Betula glandulosa, Ledum groenlandicum, Vaccinium uliginosum, V.vitis-idaea, Rubus chamaemorus, Larix laricina, Carex spp.and Alnus crispa. No species/PFT fraction is supplied.
